guatape.title: Guatapé
guatape.description: Begin your premium experience with a VIP pickup directly from your hotel. Embark on a seamless, scenic journey with exclusive stops at the Alto del Chocho viewpoint and the charming Réplica del Peñol. Conquer the monolithic El Peñol rock to marvel at breathtaking panoramic views of the reservoir, and conclude your day strolling through the vibrantly colored streets of Guatapé town. A fully private tour, tailored entirely to your pace and comfort.

medellin.title: Medellín
medellin.description: Explore the true essence of Medellin with a private, tailor-made city tour. We will dive into the incredible transformation of the vibrant Comuna 13 and its famous street art. You will experience the local culture by riding the iconic Metro and Metrocable, offering unparalleled panoramic views of the valley. Step back in time at the traditional Pueblito Paisa, and to top it all off at your own pace, we will end the day at the spectacular Mirador El Cielo to take in the breathtaking city skyline. A VIP experience, totally exclusive and unhurried.
medellin.fee_note: No hidden fees. Pay directly on tour day.

cafe.title: Coffee Farm Experience
cafe.description: Immerse yourself in authentic Colombian coffee culture with a VIP experience just minutes away from the city. During this immersive 5-hour journey, we will pick you up from your hotel and take you to a traditional farm where you will discover the entire specialty coffee process, from seed to the perfect cup. Enjoy a guided tasting by local experts in a breathtaking natural setting. A fully private tour, designed to awaken your senses at your own pace.
cafe.fee_note: No hidden fees. Pay directly on tour day.

aeropuerto.title: VIP Airport Transfer (MDE)
aeropuerto.description: Start or end your journey with maximum comfort. Private transfer service in premium vehicles to or from the José María Córdova International Airport.
aeropuerto.fee_note: Price per vehicle, not per person.

reviews.name: Sarah Jenkins
reviews.text: An incredible experience in Guatapé. The service was flawless from hotel pick-up to drop-off. Our guide knew every hidden spot.

reviews.name: Michael T.
reviews.text: I don't usually leave reviews, but the level of detail from MR Medellín is next level. The SUV was immaculate and the coffee farm was very exclusive.

reviews.name: David & Emma
reviews.text: We booked the airport transfer and ended up booking all our tours with them. Luxury, punctuality, and warmth.
